review_candidates.title: Head of Asian Market Solutions
review_candidates.description: The Head of Asian Market Solutions is accountable for defining and executing Manulife Bank’s Asian Market growth strategy. Reporting to the AVP, Specialized Lending Distribution, the role provides integrated leadership to the Specialized Lending Sales and Retail Sales teams serving Asian Markets and is responsible for accelerating sustainable growth across the Bank’s full product suite—from complex insurance lending solutions to residential mortgages and deposits. As the senior face of Manulife Bank’s Asian Market strategy, the incumbent builds trusted relationships with the leaders of Asian Market MGAs and firms, as well as Asian Market divisions within mass-market MGAs and firms. The role connects market insight, distribution leadership, talent, events, education and enterprise partnerships to expand Manulife’s relevance and performance within Asian Markets. Position Responsibilities Asian Market Strategy and Business Growth Develop and execute a differentiated, enterprise-aligned Asian Market strategy that delivers profitable growth, deeper advisor engagement and increased client reach. Translate market intelligence, advisor needs, competitive activity and community trends into focused business plans, priorities and growth opportunities. Tailor strategies, communications, advisor engagement, events, training and team practices through the lens of Asian cultures, recognizing the diversity of communities and ensuring market activities are culturally relevant and effective. Lead business development across Manulife Bank’s product portfolio, including sophisticated insurance lending, specialized credit, residential mortgages and deposit solutions. Establish clear objectives, performance measures and operating rhythms; monitor results and adjust plans to deliver sustainable outcomes. Identify opportunities to improve the end-to-end advisor and client experience while maintaining appropriate risk, compliance and conduct standards. Sales Leadership and Talent Provide strategic and people leadership to the Specialized Lending Sales and Retail Sales teams supporting Asian Markets. Recruit, hire, onboard, coach and retain high-performing talent with the capabilities and cultural fluency required to serve advisors and clients effectively. Create an inclusive, accountable and high-performance environment in which colleagues have clear priorities, strong coaching and the resources required to succeed. Build leadership and sales capability through regular performance discussions, development planning, field coaching and succession management. Promote disciplined pipeline management, collaboration and appropriate cross-referrals across product and distribution teams. Market Leadership and Strategic Partnerships Serve as Manulife Bank’s senior representative and visible advocate for its Asian Market strategy. Build and maintain executive relationships with the heads of Asian Market MGAs and firms and with leaders of Asian Market divisions within mass-market organizations. Develop joint business plans and strategic initiatives that strengthen advisor adoption, client outcomes and Manulife’s market presence. Represent market opportunities, barriers and partner feedback within Manulife Bank, influencing priorities and solutions across the organization. Protect and enhance Manulife’s reputation through professional representation, sound judgement and a strong commitment to advisor and client interests. Advisor Education, Events and Market Activation Set the strategic direction for Asian Market events, sponsorships, advisor forums and community-based business development activities. Ensure investments in events are aligned to defined audiences, measurable business objectives, brand standards and commercial priorities. Lead the development and delivery of relevant training for Asian advisor partners across lending, mortgage and deposit solutions. Partner with subject-matter experts to translate complex products and processes into clear, practical education that enables advisors to identify and advance suitable opportunities. Use participation, engagement, pipeline and business results to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve market activation. Build effective partnerships with product, credit, underwriting, operations, marketing, compliance, risk and other distribution leaders to remove barriers and enable responsible growth. Provide informed executive-level recommendations on priorities, investments, talent and market opportunities. Lead change with clarity, ensuring teams and partners understand the strategy, their role and the expected outcomes. Proven experience leading leaders and sales professionals, including recruitment, coaching, performance management and talent development. Established capability in executive relationship management, strategic partnerships, event strategy and advisor education. Strong understanding of Asian advisor and client markets in Canada, including the diversity of communities, business models and distribution needs within those markets. Excellent strategic thinking, commercial acumen, communication, influence and change-leadership skills. review_candidates.description: Gerente Financiero Ubicación: Ciudad de Guatemala, Guatemala (casa matriz), con viajes a los países de operación. Modalidad: Presencial, tiempo completo. Reporta a: Alta Dirección. Presenta información a la Junta Directiva y a su Comité de Finanzas y Auditoría. Propósito del puesto Dirigir la función financiera de un grupo multinacional de ciberseguridad, para que la Junta Directiva y la Alta Dirección cuenten con información financiera oportuna, exacta y confiable, y para que el crecimiento de la empresa se traduzca en rentabilidad, liquidez y valor sostenible. Responsabilidades principales •     Planeación financiera y presupuesto: formular el presupuesto anual por dirección, país y línea de negocio; dar seguimiento mensual y proponer medidas correctivas. •     Cierre y consolidación: asegurar el cierre contable mensual en los primeros días hábiles de cada mes y la consolidación de los estados financieros del grupo bajo NIIF. •     Información para la dirección: preparar el tablero financiero mensual y los informes para la Junta Directiva, con rentabilidad por país, línea de negocio y cliente. •     Tesorería y liquidez: administrar el flujo de caja proyectado, la relación con los bancos, la estructura de financiamiento y el cumplimiento de sus condiciones. •     Capital de trabajo: gestionar la cobranza, los inventarios y los pagos a proveedores para optimizar el ciclo de caja. •     Costeo y precios: implementar, junto con las áreas comercial y de servicios, el costeo de servicios y la política de precios y márgenes mínimos. •     Fiscalidad y cumplimiento: supervisar las obligaciones tributarias en los países de operación, las operaciones entre compañías del grupo y la relación con la auditoría externa. •     Control interno: fortalecer los controles financieros, las políticas escritas y la matriz de autorizaciones, en coordinación con Auditoría Interna. •     Sistemas: asegurar que el sistema ERP (SAP) sea la fuente única de la información financiera, con reportes automatizados por país y unidad. •     Liderazgo: dirigir y desarrollar los equipos de Tesorería, Contabilidad y Logística en los países de operación. Requisitos •     Formación: licenciatura en Contaduría Pública y Auditoría, Finanzas, Economía o Administración de Empresas. Maestría en Finanzas o MBA. •     Experiencia: mínimo 10 años en finanzas corporativas, de los cuales al menos 5 como director o gerente financiero de un grupo multinacional o con operaciones en varios países. •     Conocimientos técnicos: consolidación de estados financieros bajo NIIF; planeación financiera y presupuesto; tesorería y financiamiento bancario; costeo y rentabilidad por línea de negocio; tributación en Centroamérica. •     Sistemas: dominio de SAP u otro ERP de clase mundial y de herramientas de análisis de información. Power BI, Tableu, otros. •     Idioma: inglés, oral y escrito. •     Deseable: colegiado activo o certificación CPA; experiencia en empresas de tecnología, servicios profesionales o modelos de ingreso recurrente; experiencia en reestructuración de financiamiento y en procesos de fusión o adquisición. Características de liderazgo El puesto requiere un líder que combine el rigor técnico con la visión de negocio y que conduzca la función financiera como un aliado estratégico de la Alta Dirección. Se espera que demuestre las siguientes características: •     Liderazgo estratégico. Actúa como socio de negocio de la Alta Dirección: anticipa riesgos y oportunidades y convierte el análisis financiero en recomendaciones concretas para la toma de decisiones. •     Rendición de cuentas. Establece objetivos claros para su equipo, mide resultados y asume la responsabilidad por la exactitud y la oportunidad de la información financiera. •     Conducción del cambio. Lidera la modernización de los procesos, los sistemas y los controles financieros, y logra la adopción de nuevas prácticas en equipos de varios países. •     Firmeza con criterio. Sostiene posiciones técnicas ante presiones comerciales u operativas, con argumentos sólidos y con respeto por sus interlocutores. •     Desarrollo de talento. Selecciona, forma y retiene profesionales de alto desempeño; delega con criterio y prepara a sus sucesores. •     Ejemplaridad. Su conducta es coherente con los valores de la empresa y constituye un referente de integridad para la organización. Relacionamiento El Director Financiero mantiene relaciones permanentes con interlocutores internos y externos de alto nivel. De la calidad de esas relaciones depende la confianza en la información y en la gestión financiera de la empresa. Relaciones internas •     Junta Directiva y Comité de Finanzas y Auditoría: interlocutor principal en materia financiera; presenta la información con claridad y transparencia y responde con oportunidad a sus requerimientos. •     Dirección General y Alta Dirección: asesor de confianza en las decisiones de inversión, financiamiento, precios y portafolio de negocios. •     Directores, gerentes de país y responsables de unidad: socio de negocio que les proporciona información oportuna sobre su rentabilidad y los acompaña en la formulación y el control de su presupuesto. •     Auditoría Interna: relación de colaboración, con pleno respeto a su independencia. Relaciones externas •     Bancos e instituciones financieras: relación de largo plazo basada en la credibilidad; negociación de las condiciones de financiamiento. •     Auditores externos y autoridades tributarias: relación técnica, transparente y oportuna en cada uno de los países de operación. •     Fabricantes y proveedores estratégicos: negociación de condiciones de crédito y de pago. •     Asesores legales, fiscales y aseguradoras: coordinación de los asuntos financieros, tributarios y de cobertura de riesgos del grupo. Ofrecemos salario competitivo acorde con el mercado, esquema variable por cumplimiento de cuota, beneficios de la empresa y acceso a las certificaciones de los fabricantes representados. Esta posição terá um impacto direto na qualidade da informação financeira, suporte à tomada de decisão da gestão e relacionamento com acionistas e stakeholders de elevado nível. Funções: Estruturar e consolidar os processos de fecho mensal e reporting financeiro; Garantir a qualidade, consistência e fiabilidade da informação financeira disponibilizada à gestão; Desenvolver modelos de controlo de gestão, análise de rentabilidade e acompanhamento de performance do negócio; Produzir reporting executivo para Administração e acionistas, assegurando uma análise crítica dos principais indicadores; Apoiar a definição de estratégias de pricing, rentabilidade e crescimento sustentável; Implementar demonstrações de resultados por unidade de negócio, produto ou projeto; Assegurar a articulação entre a contabilidade financeira e as necessidades de reporting de gestão; Preparar a organização para processos de auditoria, due diligence ou potenciais operações societárias futuras; Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, ferramentas e sistemas de controlo financeiro. Requesitos: Formação superior em Gestão, Economia, Finanças, Contabilidade ou área similar; Experiência consolidada em funções de Direção Financeira, Controlo de Gestão ou Financial Planning & Analysis; Sólidos conhecimentos de contabilidade, fiscalidade portuguesa e normas SNC; Experiência na produção de reporting executivo e análise financeira para órgãos de decisão; Capacidade de implementar processos, metodologias e ferramentas de gestão financeira; Perfil hands-on, com forte orientação para execução e melhoria contínua;Elevada capacidade analítica, espírito crítico e orientação para resultados; Excelentes competências de comunicação e influência junto de diferentes stakeholders; Fluência em inglês. Se procura um desafio onde possa combinar visão estratégica, proximidade ao negócio e capacidade de execução, esta poderá ser a oportunidade certa para dar o próximo passo na sua carreira. review_candidates.title: Director of Talent Acquisition
review_candidates.description: Join our dynamic corporate team and become part of Aman Group. With offices strategically located around the world (Zug, London, Dubai, Singapore, Bangkok, Miami and New York), our corporate colleagues are at the forefront of driving innovation and excellence for our ultra-luxury brand. Role Based in Aman’s Switzerland Corporate Office, the Director of Talent Acquisition is responsible for shaping and delivering Aman Group’s global talent acquisition strategy, ensuring the organisation continues to attract, engage and hire exceptional talent across both Corporate and operational leadership functions. Reporting to the Global Head of Talent, this role leads corporate recruitment globally while supporting key leadership appointments across the portfolio, including new property openings. The Director of Talent Acquisition will drive strategic workforce planning, enhance direct sourcing capabilities and elevate the Aman Group’s talent acquisition practices, systems and employer brand. Combining strategic vision with operational excellence, the role will champion a proactive, relationship-led and high-touch approach to talent acquisition that reflects Aman’s culture, values and commitment to excellence. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring Aman continues to attract world-class talent to support its growth, innovation and long-term success worldwide. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end recruitment for corporate functions globally and support the hiring of key property leadership roles, including General Managers and Hotel Managers. Develop and deliver the Group’s global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning hiring plans with Aman’s long-term growth and business objectives. Partner with senior leaders and hiring managers to design workforce plans, forecast talent needs and build succession pipelines. Drive talent acquisition for new property openings, ensuring critical roles are identified and filled in line with opening timelines. Build and maintain strong talent pipelines through direct sourcing, networking, internal talent mobility and the Aman Alumni community. Champion Aman’s employer brand and talent attraction strategy, ensuring a best-in-class candidate experience across all touchpoints. Establish strategic partnerships with leading hospitality schools, universities and industry networks to attract future talent for internship and management development programmes. Lead, coach and develop the Talent Acquisition team and support capability building across the global recruitment community. Optimise recruitment systems and technologies, including Workday and LinkedIn Recruiter, while managing external search partners and agencies. Monitor recruitment performance through data, analytics and market insights, providing strategic recommendations and ensuring effective budget management. Requirements 10+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition and/or Executive Search experience in luxury hospitality, lifestyle or high-end service environments Proven experience developing and executing talent acquisition strategies globally, including workforce planning, executive hiring, succession planning and talent pipeline development Global experience, with a track record of recruiting across diverse markets, cultures and geographies, including pre-opening recruitment and workforce planning in remote destinations; understanding of Saudization requirements preferred Commercially minded, with the ability to align talent strategies with business priorities and organisational growth objectives Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, advise and build trusted partnerships at executive level Advanced experience in recruitment technologies and applicant tracking systems, particularly Workday Highly professional, culturally aware and emotionally intelligent, with the credibility to represent the Aman brand and engage senior talent globally Demonstrated success leading and developing property-based recruiters across the portfolio. Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with proficiency in English; additional languages are an advantage Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Hospitality Management or a related discipline Willingness to relocate to Switzerland Benefits At Aman Group, we believe that our colleagues are at the core of our success. We offer a competitive benefits including exciting international career opportunities in a company that is expanding rapidly. We prioritise and support your career journey, making you feel valued, included and at home. If you thrive in an ultra-luxury environment and are passionate about warm and personalised hospitality where every detail matters, we invite you to apply to join us on our journey.
